title: Paneer Masala
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

        Paneer

        Tomatoes

        onion

        red chilli powder 

        coriander powder

        cumin powder

        turmeric powder

        garam masala

        How to prepare
        1. In a pan add some oil
        2. Then add 1 onion, 3 tomatoes and some salt and fry for 2 minutes
        3. Now, add some red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, ginger garlic paste
        4. Fry until tomatoes and onions are cooked well and now keep them aside and let it cool .
        5. Now, in a mixer grinder add the fried items and grind it into paste.

        6. In a pan add 2 tablespoon of oil add some cumin seed and ground paste then fry for 2 minutes
        7. Now, add fried paneer into the mixture and bring it into a boil 
        8. Add some garam masla and heavy cream and salt to taste

        Serve this with hot rotis and naan or some hot rice, and enjoy!
